gen-fs-bevellier-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Bevellier cuts its letters flat, like stencils, with tight sidebearings that crowd every glyph together. And Schibsted Grotesk loosens things below, its generous e and a giving the lines room to breathe.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-yaldevi: Flat and stencil-cut, Bevellier hums along in a soft, featureless texture with barely a gap between letters. Yaldevi follows with outsized lowercase and an e that opens clearly to the right, so paragraphs slide by easily.
gen-fs-comico-gf-julius-sans-one: Whimsical and commanding, Comico pours its lowercase like lead type and spreads words wide. Julius Sans One does the reverse job, with near-matching capital and lowercase heights and open-ended curves for quiet text.
gen-fs-expose-gf-amiko: Compressed and striking: Expose barely separates x-height from caps, while Amiko opens outward with tong-like terminals and crayon-bold lowercase. The sharp compression against those open terminals is the draw.
gen-fs-expose-gf-anek-bangla: Expose squeezes x-height almost up to cap height, leaving a compressed cadence with hardly a pause. But Anek Bangla relaxes with wide, barely curled s curves, and that tension is what holds the pair.
gen-fs-expose-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Expose squeezes capitals and x-height almost level and moves in a compressed cadence, with very little pause. Give Anek Gurmukhi the smaller size and its open counters carry the text.
gen-fs-expose-gf-anek-kannada: Expose runs capitals and lowercase nearly level in a compressed cadence, while Anek Kannada lifts its x-height like a squared-off woodblock letter. Terminals stop well back from the stem, so text moves along openly.
gen-fs-expose-gf-biryani: Expose packs x-height and caps almost shoulder to shoulder, its compressed cadence leaving hardly a pause. Biryani relaxes into large-eyed e's and unmodulated strokes, an unclogged texture that is the pair's best trait.
gen-fs-expose-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Expose crams its x-height right up against the caps, barely pausing. Carrois Gothic SC also keeps caps and lowercase close, yet its curves open clearly, and that release is the hook.
gen-fs-expose-gf-golos-text: Expose is built for impact, pressing x-height and caps nearly together in a compressed cadence with very little pause. Golos Text handles the quiet work: a tall x-height, a widely parted s.
